description: Renovate is scoped to the vertical-pod-autoscaler project only; the rest of the repository is handled by Dependabot. Policy: Docker base images and Kubernetes modules get patch updates on master and the three latest release branches; golang.org/x modules get minor updates everywhere; all other Go modules are kept at latest on master and get patch updates on release branches. Note: Renovate applies dep-level `enabled: false` rules before version lookup and cannot undo them with update-type rules afterwards, so restrictions below are expressed via matchUpdateTypes rather than blanket disables.

packageRules.description: 1. Docker images: patch updates only, on every branch. Go minor bumps are done manually.
1. Docker images: one PR per branch.
Go modules: only propose versions whose go.mod `go` directive is satisfied by ours, so dependency bumps never force a Go minor bump.
Go modules: also update indirect dependencies. Rules that restrict indirect updates must come after this one.
Go modules: indirect dependencies cannot be moved to a new major (module path) by us; the importing dependency has to do that.

Go modules: pre-modules +incompatible pseudo-versions cannot follow newer commits once upstream adds a go.mod with a /vN module path (e.g. github.com/mistifyio/go-zfs -> /v4); the importing dependency has to make that move.
Go modules: github.com/euank/go-kmsg-parser's v2.0.1 tag ships a go.mod without the /v2 module path, so Go rejects it; stay on v2.0.0+incompatible.
6. Go modules: fsnotify is locked at 1.9.0 on every branch, matching the gomodguard restriction in vertical-pod-autoscaler/.golangci.yaml (see https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/138865).

2. Kubernetes modules: patch updates only, on every branch, bundled into one PR. This also blocks the independent digest bumps of untagged k8s.io/kube-openapi and k8s.io/utils, which must track the apimachinery release. separateMinorPatch makes Renovate offer the highest patch even though the minor is blocked.
3.-5. Everything that is not a Kubernetes module goes into one PR per branch. On master this means latest versions; the release-branch rules below narrow it down.
Release branches: no major, digest or replacement updates for any Go module. Digests track untagged default-branch commits, which are never patch-level.

3. and 5. Release branches: no minor updates either, except golang.org/x/* which are permanently pre-1.0 and ship fixes as minor bumps. separateMinorPatch makes Renovate offer the highest patch even though the minor is blocked.
